```{r}
#| label: setup
library(pondeR)
library(dimsprepr)
library(gt)
library(knitr)

# Everything comes from render_metabolomics(): preprocessed data + user overrides
spec <- readRDS(params$spec_file)
di   <- spec$di
over <- spec$over

# Run a pondeR/dimsprepr function with workflow defaults; user overrides win
wf <- function(fn, ...) pondeR:::.wf_call(fn, list(...), over)

# run_DIpreprocess standardizes metadata column names
std <- function(std_nm, user_nm) if (std_nm %in% names(di$metadata)) std_nm else user_nm
g   <- std("Group", spec$group_col)
sid <- std("Sample", spec$sample_id_col)
qc  <- spec$qc_types
groups <- setdiff(unique(as.character(di$metadata[[g]])), qc)
multi  <- length(groups) > 2  # >2 groups: PLS-DA overall, pairwise ROC

is_valid_pls <- function(p) {
  !inherits(p, "error") && inherits(p, "run_pls") &&
    NCOL(p$scores) >= 2 && !all(is.na(p$variance_explained))
}
```

# Settings

```{r}
p <- di$parameters
as_gt(data.frame(
  Setting = c("Normalization", "Normalization factor column", "Transformation",
              "Scaling (non-PLS / PLS)", "Drift/batch correction", "QC labels", "Groups"),
  Value = c(paste(p$normalize_method, collapse = ", "),
            if (is.null(p$norm_factor_col)) "none" else p$norm_factor_col,
            paste(p$transform_method, collapse = ", "),
            paste(p$scale_nonpls, "/", p$scale_pls),
            if (isTRUE(p$correct_drift)) "yes" else "no",
            paste(qc, collapse = ", "), paste(groups, collapse = ", "))))
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (length(over)) {
  cat("User-specified arguments (everything else uses workflow defaults):\n\n")
  ov <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(over), function(fn)
    data.frame(Function = fn, Argument = names(over[[fn]]),
               Value = vapply(over[[fn]], function(v) paste(deparse(v), collapse = " "), ""))))
  cat(knitr::knit_print(as_gt(ov)), "\n\n")
}
```

# Preprocessing

```{r}
as_gt(di$dimensions)
```

```{r}
tab <- table(di$metadata[[g]])
as_gt(rbind(data.frame(Group = names(tab), n = as.integer(tab)),
            data.frame(Group = "Total", n = sum(tab))))
```

## Before vs. after batch / drift correction

```{r}
if (isTRUE(di$parameters$correct_drift) && !is.null(di$data_corrected)) {
  wf("plot_beforeafter", di$data_imputed, di$data_corrected, di$metadata,
     plot_what = head(intersect(di$features_final, colnames(di$data_corrected)), 6),
     col_injection = std("InjectionSequence", spec$injection_col),
     col_batch = std("Batch", spec$batch_col),
     col_group = g, col_qc_label = qc,
     x_label = "Before correction", y_label = "After correction")
} else cat("Drift/batch correction was not applied.")
```

## Before vs. after preprocessing

```{r}
# Same features on both sides (features removed by filtering are dropped from "before")
raw_kept <- di$data_raw[, colnames(di$data_nonpls), drop = FALSE]
wf("plot_dist_beforeafter", raw_kept, di$data_nonpls, group_by = "sample",
   plot_title = "Samples view")
wf("plot_dist_beforeafter", raw_kept, di$data_nonpls, group_by = "feature",
   plot_title = "Features view")
```

# PCA

```{r}
pca <- suppressWarnings(wf("run_pca", di, group = g, exclude = qc, verbose = FALSE))
wf("plot_score", pca, color_by = g, points_from = sid)
```

# OPLS-DA (PLS-DA fallback)

QC samples are dropped by `run_pls()` automatically for `run_DIpreprocess`
input. With two groups OPLS-DA is tried first and PLS-DA is the fallback; with
more than two groups only PLS-DA is used.

```{r}
fit_pls <- function(method) tryCatch(
  suppressWarnings(wf("run_pls", di, group = g, method = method, verbose = FALSE)),
  error = function(e) e)
pls <- if (multi) fit_pls("plsda") else fit_pls("oplsda")
if (!multi && !is_valid_pls(pls)) {
  cat("OPLS-DA produced no usable model",
      if (inherits(pls, "error")) paste0("(", conditionMessage(pls), ")"),
      "- falling back to PLS-DA.\n\n")
  pls <- fit_pls("plsda")
}
if (is_valid_pls(pls)) {
  wf("plot_score", pls, color_by = g, points_from = sid)
} else {
  cat("PLS-DA also produced no usable model - skipped.")
  pls <- NULL
}
```

# Differential analysis

## Fold change

```{r}
fc <- wf("run_foldchange", di, from = "normalized", up = 1.5, down = 1 / 1.5)
as_gt(head(fc$summary_table, 20))
```

## t-test / ANOVA

`run_diff()` selects the test automatically (t-test / Wilcoxon for 2 groups,
ANOVA / Kruskal-Wallis for more) and adjusts p-values across features.

```{r}
dif <- tryCatch(wf("run_diff", di, outcome = colnames(di$data_nonpls), summary_table = TRUE),
                error = function(e) e)
if (inherits(dif, "error")) {
  cat("run_diff failed:", conditionMessage(dif)); dif <- NULL
} else as_gt(dif$summary_table)
```

## Volcano plot

```{r}
vdat <- if (!is.null(dif)) wf("get_volcanodata", fc, dif) else NULL
# Without run_diff results plot_volcano() returns a mean abundance plot instead
vol <- wf("plot_volcano", if (is.null(dif)) list(fc) else list(fc, dif), y = "fold_change",
          z = if (!is.null(dif) && "p_value_adj" %in% names(dif$summary_table)) "p_value_adj" else "p_value")
invisible(lapply(vol$plots, print))
if (is.null(vdat) || nrow(vdat) == 0) {
  cat("\n\nNo features passed the fold change and p-value thresholds;",
      "showing mean abundance per group instead.\n\n")
  keep <- !di$metadata[[g]] %in% qc
  print(wf("plot_meanmap", di$data_nonpls[keep, , drop = FALSE],
           metadata = di$metadata[keep, , drop = FALSE], group = g))
} else {
  as_gt(vdat)
}
```

# ROC analysis

Uses, when available, the VIP scores (PLS-DA/OPLS-DA), fold change and
t-test/ANOVA results to select candidate features (thresholds: VIP, `up`/`down`,
`p_value` defaults of `run_auc()`). With more than two groups, ROC is run for
every pair of groups, each with its own pairwise PLS-DA, fold change and test.

```{r}
#| results: asis
pairs <- if (multi) combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE) else list(groups)

roc_pair <- function(pr) {
  if (!multi) {
    inputs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(di, pls, fc, dif))
    return(wf("run_auc", inputs, set_control = spec$control_group, plot = "all"))
  }
  drop <- c(qc, setdiff(groups, pr))
  p_pls <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(wf("run_pls", di, group = g, method = "plsda",
                                         exclude = drop, verbose = FALSE)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
  p_fc  <- wf("run_foldchange", di, from = "normalized", filter = drop,
              up = 1.5, down = 1 / 1.5)
  p_dif <- tryCatch(wf("run_diff", di, outcome = colnames(di$data_nonpls), filter = drop,
                       summary_table = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  inputs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(di, if (is_valid_pls(p_pls)) p_pls, p_fc, p_dif))
  wf("run_auc", inputs, remove = drop, set_control = pr[1], plot = "all")
}

roc <- lapply(pairs, function(pr) tryCatch(roc_pair(pr), error = function(e) e))
names(roc) <- vapply(pairs, paste, character(1), collapse = " vs ")

for (nm_pair in names(roc)) {
  r <- roc[[nm_pair]]
  cat("\n\n## ", nm_pair, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (inherits(r, "error")) {
    cat("ROC analysis failed: ", conditionMessage(r), "\n\n", sep = "")
  } else if (is.null(r$auc_table) || nrow(r$auc_table) == 0) {
    cat("No features passed the filtering criteria.\n\n")
  } else {
    cat(knitr::knit_print(as_gt(r$auc_table)), "\n\n")
    invisible(lapply(r$plots, print))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| include: false
saveRDS(list(preprocess = di, pca = pca, pls = pls, foldchange = fc, diff = dif, roc = roc),
        spec$results_file)
```
